fusions.name: Pressure Ping
fusions.desc: Sends a pulse into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Shrill Colony
fusions.desc: Looses 4 darts at once, each dealing 9 damage and stunning what it hits for 0.8 seconds. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Vibrant Echo] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Dark Shoal
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds and raises your movement speed by 10%. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

fusions.name: Lateral Sense
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a blow that would land on you is rolled again for a dodge, and the second roll stands. Its effect grows 9% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
